name: conditional-missing-positive
rationale: Missing positive predicate is false; conditional capability does not invent a value.

name: conditional-missing-negation
rationale: NOT of the false missing-field predicate is true.

name: unsupported-negation
rationale: Unsupported capability cannot be replaced by missing-field negation.

name: unused-unsupported-alias
rationale: Unused unsupported CommandLine does not block a supported Image-only expression.

name: or-cannot-bypass-capability
rationale: All compiled expression fields are checked before event short-circuiting.

name: capability-before-quality
rationale: The specified capability gate precedes event eligibility.

name: source-before-capability
rationale: A known mismatching source is inapplicable before capability and quality gates.

name: unknown-source
rationale: Unknown source policy cannot be evaluated.

name: invalid-before-inapplicable
rationale: A null ECS field is invalid input even for an inapplicable rule.

name: conditional-warning-negation
rationale: A nonblocking capture warning retains existing NOT-on-missing behavior.
